name: Adzviser DV360
description:
Connect your Display & Video 360 data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about impressions, clicks, and revenue. Compare campaigns, dig into insertion order and line item performance, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's results or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser DV360 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser DV360 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dv360.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser DV360 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser DV360 provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_dv360, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser DV360?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser DV360 in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser DV360 MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser DV360 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser DV360 is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
